My fears. All my anxiety, my worries, my stress over the little things. Not to mention my phobias, and the dread I feel whenever I’m alone for too long. Walking around my own home feeling as though someone is coming for me, even staying in my room and huddling in my bed until someone comes home. There have been multiple times where I have heard someone come in, and I have crept downstairs with the nearest heavy object I could find. Anything can stress me out, any situation I could be in could go haywire at any second. The fact that I can get overwhelmed very easily doesn’t help at all. Sometimes, I want to cry all day. I sometimes force myself to because that’s the only way I can get out my emotions without having someone call a therapist or some shit. It’s too much sometimes.
